role: Red Team Inquisitor — GPU Engine & Low-Spec Torture Auditor

self_fixes_applied.title: Low-Spec MAX_3D_TEXTURE_SIZE Driver Limit & Automatic 2x Decimation Fallback
self_fixes_applied.fix: Added safe driver query gl.getParameter(gl.MAX_3D_TEXTURE_SIZE) with fallback; implemented downsampleVolumeData() providing automatic 2x/4x stride decimation when volume dimensions exceed GPU driver texture limits.

self_fixes_applied.title: Drawing Buffer Thrashing Elimination & Explicit Core WebGL2 VAO Lifecycle
self_fixes_applied.fix: Pre-sized offscreen canvas in renderAllPlanes to max(W, H, D) to eliminate 180 buffer reallocations/sec; created, bound, and cleanly disposed Core WebGL2 Vertex Array Object (VAO).

self_fixes_applied.title: Oblique Slice FOV Truncation Repair via Diagonal Span Expansion
self_fixes_applied.fix: Expanded slice widthPx and heightPx to full 3D diagonal sqrt(W^2 + H^2) when rotated obliquely, ensuring zero anatomical cutoff (TMJ, wisdom teeth, ramus).

self_fixes_applied.title: MinIP Air Dropout & Border Smearing Elimination
self_fixes_applied.fix: Removed eps border smearing from sampleHUTrilinear; in MinIP loop, discarded out-of-bounds air samples (hu > -999.0), preventing bone blackout.

self_fixes_applied.title: Invert / White Paper Mode Sigmoid Smooth Transition
self_fixes_applied.fix: Replaced harsh -600 HU step discontinuity with continuous sigmoid smoothstep(-650.0, -550.0, finalHU) and smooth dark air blending.

self_fixes_applied.title: Sub-Pixel Phase Shudder Elimination
self_fixes_applied.fix: Created worldMmToSlicePxContinuous and integrated into computeGlSliceCoordinates, eliminating 1-pixel discontinuous phase jumps during crosshair scrubbing.
